visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young girls are on a wooden floor in a home setting. The girl on the left wears a beige t-shirt with a turnip graphic and brown shorts, standing near a wooden walker filled with toys. The girl on the right sits on the floor wearing a white t-shirt with a bee logo and lavender shorts. They play with a small stack of blue and wooden blocks. (2) The older girl in white tries to stack more blocks, but the tower collapses, scattering wooden cubes across the floor. She smiles and claps her hands in excitement. The younger girl watches intently while holding the handle of the wooden walker. (3) Both children begin picking up the scattered blocks and tossing them back into the wooden walker. The wooden floor is cluttered with various colorful blocks. A bookshelf filled with picture books is visible in the background against a plain wall. (4) A new phase of stacking begins. The girls take turns placing rectangular and square wooden blocks on top of each other, creating a taller tower. An adult's hand enters the frame from the bottom right to help steady the growing stack as it reaches the height of the seated girl's head. (5) The tower grows significantly taller, consisting of nearly ten levels of alternating colored and natural wood blocks. The older girl carefully places a yellow cylinder on top while the younger girl walks around to the side. The adult's hand continues to guide the placement. (6) The younger girl moves behind her wooden walker and begins pushing it toward the tall tower. She looks focused as she aims the cart. The older girl watches from the side, anticipating the move. (7) The younger girl pushes the wooden walker with force, crashing it directly into the base of the tall block tower. The entire structure collapses in a loud scatter. The children and adults laugh and cheer as the play session concludes. (8) The screen transitions to a simple hand-drawn animation on a yellow background, depicting a boy lying down and a girl standing, with text appearing below them.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, happy acoustic guitar BGM. A male voice introduces the scene in a friendly tone. A sharp wooden clatter occurs as blocks fall, followed by a child's high-pitched exclamation and laughter. (2) A distinct, sharp 'Ding' SFX plays. The male narrator says 'Diao!' (fell) with a rising intonation. There is a continuous background of soft shuffling on a wooden floor. (3) Rapid wooden clacking sounds occur as blocks are tossed into a container. The BGM remains steady with a light percussive beat. A female voice joins in with encouraging words for the kids. (4) A sequence of individual wooden 'clicks' marks each block being stacked. The pitch of the narrators' voices varies as they guide the children, using high-arousal and positive tones. (5) The BGM continues as the frequency of speech increases. The older girl says 'Ni kan pao' (Look) with high pitch. More block clicks and soft thuds are heard as the tower builds. (6) A low rolling sound of wooden wheels on the floor emerges. The female voice speaks softly, 'Man man o' (Slowly). The music stays bright and cheery in the background. (7) A loud, multi-layered wooden crash (broadband burst) signifies the tower collapsing. This is immediately followed by high-arousal cheering, laughter from the adults and children, and a brief burst of applause. (8) The audio concludes with a short, melodic piano stinger jingle that fades out as the visual animation appears, ending the production.
